speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Good afternoon, would you be kind enough to donate $1 to Save The Children fund today?

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: I don't know. What is the fund for?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: The funds are used to promote children's rights and well-being in developing countries

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: What kind of well-being?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: It provides medical needs, education. And in some cases, relief in war torn areas

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: Oh that sounds good. Who runs it?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: It was founded in 1919 by Eglantyne Jebb  in London, in the wake of World War I. It soon becomes the first global movement for children. It is ran by a Board of Trustees

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: Oh. Well, I don't know if it can be trusted or not to send the funds to the right place?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Our independently audited financial statements consistently show that nearly 9 out of every 10 dollars we spend goes to programs and services for children and families in need. We keep administrative costs low so that more funding goes to children's programs.

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: That's good. I like charities that don't have high administrative costs. Do you work for the organization?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: I volunteer after noticing how much wasteful I was with the pennies. They can use every little they can get

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: Okay. I don't even understand what that means.

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Imagine how you spend those pennies laying around. You can use those to donate to Save the Children

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: I see. That is a good thought, but I'm not usually very wasteful with my money, even my pennies. Every penny counts after all.

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: That's great to hear. How about putting some that to use today. I guarantee a $1.50 to Save the Children will actually give you a great feeling of satisfaction

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: Would I get to designate what country it gets spent in or on what project?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: All projects and audit reports are listed for the public. So you'd be able to see how the money is used

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: I know. But would I get to indicate a preference of where or how I want it spent?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Yes! If you chose the option to sponsor a child

speaker: A2JJPWU1CMIX0O
text: Oh, well that's interesting. I'll give it some thought but I'm not ready to donate yet.

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: How about donating to the fund today while thinking about sponsoring a child?
